questions.q:
Which of the following is incorrect relationship between given concentration terms?
$\mathbf{M}=$ molarity; $\mathbf{m}=$ molality; $\mathbf{d}=$ density of solution in $\mathrm{g} / \mathrm{mL}M^{\prime}=$ molar mass of solute \left(\mathrm{g} \mathrm{mol}^{-1}\right) ; \mathbfM^{\prime \prime}=$ molar mass of solvent \left(\mathrm{g} \mathrm{mol}^{-1}\right)X^{\prime}=$ mole fraction of solute; $\mathrmX^{\prime \prime}=$ mole fraction of solvent
questions.solution: $\begin{aligned} & m=\frac{M \times 1000}{\left(1000 d-M^{\prime} \times M\right)} \\ & \frac{1}{m}=\frac{d}{M}-\frac{M^{\prime}}{1000}\end{aligned}\begin{aligned} & M=\frac{n_{\text {solute }} \times d \times 1000}{w t_{\text {solution }}}=\frac{n_{\text {solute }} \times d \times 1000}{n_{\text {solvent }} M^{\prime \prime}+n_{\text {solute }} M^{\prime}} \\ & M=\frac{x_{\text {solute }} \times d \times 1000}{x_{\text {solvent }} M^{\prime \prime}+x_{\text {solute }} M^{\prime}}\end{aligned}$
questions.source: Most Important Selected Qs for JEE Advanced

questions.solution:
If mole fraction of solute $=0.1$ then molality $=\frac{0.1 \times 1000}{0.9 \times 18}=6.17$

If solute is electrolyte ( $A B_2$ ) with $\alpha=0.5$ then $\mathrm{i}=1+2 \alpha \Rightarrow 2$

questions.q: What will be the correct order of vapour pressure of water, acetone and ether at $30^{{}^{{}^{\circ}}} \mathrm{C}$. Given that among these compounds, water has maximum boiling point and ether has minimum boiling point?
questions.solution: Greater the boiling point, less is the vapour pressure. Hence, the correct order of vapour pressure wil be Water < acetone < ether
